generation.scope: If an untested finite rank-eight planar window has no local equations through degree three, it has a single support and a common length-eight subscheme on which all four coordinates are projectively identified. Each embedding is a complete intersection of three quadrics. Its ideal is the annihilator of the square of every tangent-plane equation. Consecutive tangent planes cut length six and each tangent plane cuts length seven.

open_mathematics: Use the common octad and its three quadratic equations to compare the opposite coordinate square maps. Analyze the local quadratic and cubic initial-ideal cases and the independent rank-nine branching strata.
